result.is_agency_or_reseller: Very probably agency-run, not the builder's own page (hypothesis built on observed facts). The Facebook page is categorised Media/news company, so it is not a developer page. The RERA promoter is a different entity (Atlantis Infraspace LLP) with six named partners, none called BGSR. I found no public evidence that BGSR is a sister business of the builder, and no website or listing for it. The likely story is a local media/marketing outfit running the Meta ad and receiving the enquiries for Atlantis Hills (their page even carries the project's site address). It is not a broker/reseller, since it does not appear to sell units. This is not confirmed.
